direction: Technical editorial atlas: navy ground, ivory text, teal structure, coral heat, gold work and control; shared Source Sans 3 typography.
thesis: A heat pump uses work to transfer heat; its refrigerant circuit and its thermostat feedback loop perform different jobs.
model: Pressure reduction through an expansion valve
visible_evidence: A continuous circuit joins the four physical components
Coils and fans locate heat exchange
Colour and phase labels distinguish refrigerant states
Flow-band widths encode an illustrative 2 + 1 = 3 kW balance
A separate control view returns the room measurement
reading_order: Main circuit, energy balance, thermostat loop.
production_contract: Free editable scene, generated by scripts/gallery/heat-pump.js. Semantic cards alone cannot express coil geometry or energy proportions.
scope: Heating mode. Reversing valve, defrost and auxiliary devices omitted. Values are a worked example, not measured performance. Drawings are not to scale.
